name: HELLO Mini Yarn Packs (12 yarn balls 25g)
description:
About HELLO Cotton Yarns:

HELLO is a 100% cotton mercerized yarn. It can be used in crochet, knitting and punch embroidery projects. HELLO cotton yarns have the Oeko-Tex Standard 100 Certificate , which certifies that no harmful substances are used in the yarn. It is 100% Turkish and domestic production.

What Can You Do with HELLO?

With HELLO, you can knit amigurumi toys, baby blankets, pillows, accessories, crochet motifs, summer dresses, shawls, cardigans and baby clothes. The most preferred knitting items are baby cardigans, toys and clothes.

  • Crochet hook size: 2.5-3.5.
  • Knitting Needles size: 3

name: DIY Premium Diamond Paintings
description:
Introducing Diamond Painting Kits for kids and adults, the perfect crafting activity for those looking to create stunning gem art!

Each kit includes:

  • High quality printed canvas
  • Enough square drill diamonds (30% extra, each color in a separate zip-lock bag)
  • Pen (single diamond and multi diamond heads)
  • 2x Glue squares
  • Tweezer
  • Tray

Our gem art kits are made with high-quality materials and are carefully packaged, ensuring bright colors and clear pictures and symbols that are perfect for beginners.
